The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic Role Labeling for the sentence: "The firefighter raced into the burning building to rescue the trapped occupants, demonstrating true heroism."

Main Verb: raced

- The firefighter: Agent (the one performing the action)
- raced: Predicate (the main action)
- into the burning building: Location/Goal (where the action is directed)
- to rescue the trapped occupants: Purpose (the reason for the action)
  - rescue: Sub-predicate
  - the trapped occupants: Patient (the receiver of the sub-action)
- demonstrating true heroism: Manner/Result (accompanying action or result)
  - demonstrating: Sub-predicate
  - true heroism: Theme (what is being demonstrated)
